title: AgentAM: An AI Agent for Spatter- and Defect-Aware Process Optimization in Laser Powder Bed Fusion
title_zh: AgentAM：面向激光粉末床熔融中飞溅与缺陷感知工艺优化的AI智能体

paragraphs.en: AgentAM智能体让工程师用自然语言访问增材制造仿真模型，实现裕度感知工艺优化。 Predictive models for laser powder bed fusion (LPBF) are rarely used on the shop floor because querying them requires programming and model-specific knowledge. We present AgentAM, a large language model (LLM) agent that gives process engineers natural-language access to CFD-trained surrogates of spatter and melt pool geometry for SS316L through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Polynomial surrogates trained on 279 single-track simulations predict melt pool dimensions ($R^2 \geq 0.95$) and spatter volume ($R^2 = 0.83$ on test data) at any power-velocity point in the trained range, and geometric criteria assign each point a geometry-derived defect regime (keyhole, lack of fusion, balling or stable) that matches the regime obtained from the simulated geometry in 93.4% of tracks under cross-validation. The agent selects and parameterizes tools for prediction, process-window scans and constrained optimization. Minimum-spatter optima often sat within 10 $μ$m of the lack-of-fusion boundary; a margin-aware optimizer moved them away from all thresholds and raised the estimated probability of remaining classified Good from 0.94 to 1.00 under an assumed 2% process drift, and from 0.72 to 0.91 when jointly sampled cross-validated geometry residuals were added. About 40-50 well-spread simulations sufficed to reproduce the defect map. To evaluate the agent layer, we introduce a 145-prompt benchmark scored against direct tool calls, plus eight prompts (40 runs) on margin-aware requests. Over the 725 runs of the main benchmark the agent passed the intended inputs in 98.5% of parsing prompts, reported the scored spatter values and defect classes faithfully and met every stated constraint in the 65 feasible optimization runs, within a median 1.0% of the brute-force optimum.
paragraphs.zh: AgentAM智能体让工程师用自然语言访问增材制造仿真模型，实现裕度感知工艺优化。激光粉末床熔融（LPBF）的预测模型很少被用于车间现场，因为查询这些模型需要编程能力和模型相关的专业知识。 我们提出AgentAM，这是一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体，它通过模型上下文协议（MCP）让工艺工程师能够用自然语言访问针对SS316L训练的飞溅与熔池几何CFD代理模型。 基于279个单道仿真的多项式代理模型能够预测训练范围内任意功率-速度点的熔池尺寸（$R^2 \geq 0.95$）和飞溅体积（测试数据上$R^2 = 0.83$），并且几何判据为每个点赋予一个由几何导出的缺陷状态（匙孔、未熔合、球化或稳定），在交叉验证下与由仿真几何得到的状态在93.4%的熔道上一致。 该智能体能够为预测、工艺窗口扫描和约束优化选择工具并进行参数化。 最小飞溅的最优点往往位于距未熔合边界10 $μ$m以内；一个裕度感知优化器将其移离所有阈值，在假设2%工艺漂移的条件下，把保持被判定为Good的估计概率从0.94提高到1.00，而在加入联合采样的交叉验证几何残差后，该概率从0.72提高到0.91。 约40-50个分布良好的仿真就足以复现缺陷图。 为评估智能体层，我们引入了一个包含145个提示、以直接工具调用为基准进行评分的测试集，外加针对裕度感知请求的8个提示（40次运行）。 在主测试集的725次运行中，该智能体在98.5%的解析类提示中正确传递了预期输入，忠实地报告了参与评分的飞溅值和缺陷类别，并在65次可行优化运行中满足了所有给定约束，且结果与暴力搜索最优解的中位数偏差为1.0%。
